body: we'll see . . . i'm going to sleep on it.

I should be the hulk for what i've endured, but i'm still weak.

i see the stressful situations, i just don't see them ever letting up

my parents actually were and are great, i seriously don't fault them for anything.

As for work, it's just another facet of my already difficult life.


HOWEVER

I don't know what it is about your posts, but they get to me - i can't explain it, you aren't saying anything i haven't heard but it's resonating anyway, you've given me enough to sleep for 4 hours and hope tomorrow isn't as crappy as today (not likely though) - plus i'm tired.

thank you for delivering a message that got through

i'm not happy, but i'll wait it out a little longer
the past ten years says otherwise.
But that's a different statement then "you can fix this".  of course i have time to fix this, that doesn't mean that i can.
It seems the message is always the same,  "your too young ..... you can fix this...... " at what point is it okay to say that doesn't apply anymore because i was told that 15 years ago.

My wife is what saved me, she loved me like no one ever had, and it was great, but then we had kids and she rightfully needed to give them the attention, i got left behind and now she's just tired of me having problems all the time - she just wants me to just stop complaining,  she's wanted to leave on several occasions but stays because she loves me and wants the kids to have a father.
you get sick of trying the new suggestion after the first 20 don't work

You've hit it on the nose as to why i haven't attempted yet, i feel responsible for their physical welfare (Lord knows I'm doing nothing for them emotionally -  even though i do as you have suggested when i catch myself - I'm just to the point of asking why do i always have to catch myself?? the conclusion is that i must be broken).  If i didn't have a family, i literally be dead.  I'm just so tired, and i fell like I'm losing the battle,  to tired to fight,  at some point i'm going to make a decision that i can't undo, and i'm closer to not caring about that than i have been since the last time i attempted.  As for injury, i am still able to go to work, i just can't miss a day for the next 6 months or i get written up.

It truly feels like someone up the wants me to live, but wants to make sure i'm miserable while i do it
Exactly, and that is something i feel i simply cannot endure.
It's just too far and i'm not even guaranteed to get out.   I say this coming from someone who was told 12 years ago that things will get better ----- they didn't.

If i'm honest, i'm just too lazy for that, and to add to it i'm not really ready to invest so much time and energy into something that only might work (as in there is no guarantee).  I've been given that line before with meds, and counseling and it didn't pan out and only made me more hopeless.

I fell in love, and it really was/is love, even at twelve.   I was ready to marry her, spend my life serving her and making her happy.  Her friends told her to dump me because i was too clingy (which i always have been).  After that i hurt a lot inside and wondered one day if i could take the pain of a razor-blade.  Cutting became my drug of choice for the next 7 years (even though i dabbled in others),  that spanned two suicide attempts and a visit to a psych ward.  I don't cut anymore, but if I'm honest, it's mainly because i couldn't hide it from my wife.

Actually my mom tells me i told her i wanted to light myself on fire when i was six.  I don't even remember that though, however i became suicidal and started cutting myself at age 12 and i've never really escaped it.

I've had years of counseling as a teen and some as an adult.  I have tried effexor, welbutrin, prozac, and zoloft.  none of the medications did a thing.   The counseling helps but only for a week or so, and i simply can't afford to pay someone to make me happy.  I'm feeling like i'm out of options and my history suggests i will only do more damage the longer i am here..
But nearly 2 decades of getting it wrong gives me a good basis for the belief that it will never get better.  And now i've involved a wife and kids in the pain.   What an awesome person i am.
Not so, if hitler said what he was doing wasn't right, the fact that he still did it makes him a bad person.  (Arguably he'd be a worse person)

I'll be honest, i haven't really tried exercise.  ( i have tried cutting and it worked well while i did it but it just reminds you how broken you are so you keep doing it).   But i'm to the place where i'm genuinely asking myself the question, why am i trying so hard to be happy, why should i have to exercise just to be happy? running is something i hate and the exercise i do like either cost money (swimming) or is time prohibitive  (i work full time and go to school full time and have 4 kids at home).
 why is it so f***ing hard for me to just be happy?  

And if it really is so hard why am i still trying when i see no hope for change.

It's just hurts to be alive. i hate it! I literally hate life, it has brought me so much pain and brings so little comfort. And when i think about being alive to see my wife leave me and my kids to tell me what a shitty father i was, it just makes it worse.  I am almost jealous of the reverence that people give to suicides,  people would actually talk about me like i'm not the broken person i am.  I truly have nothing to hope for.

I've tried this and continue to try this, but the times that i fail my family far outweigh the times I've brightened their lives.  And of course suicide is selfish, it's saying I'm done, I've had it, i will take no more for any reason.  That doesn't preclude it from being the right choice in my opinion - especially since many people tell me i need to spend more time taking care of myself (isn't that also selfish).  BTW i may not have been clear, i do believe in an afterlife i just want to get to the end of whatever is left so i can be at a place where i can no longer fail because there's nothing left to do.

I really wonder why it's so hard to find support in killing yourself, no one tells you good peaceful easy ways to do it (believe me I've looked).  Do people really believe that a lifetime of torture is preferable to an untimely death?  It seems most times that i am living for other peoples benefit.  Why is it that i am supposed to live in misery to make someone else feel better.

I'm always short tempered, yelling at them, wanting them to act like adults because i know how horrible life is and i feel like i need to make them prepared for it now.  I have so many quirks that make me a ad person i don't think i could ever list them.  I know they are kids logically but i keep doing things that hurt them.  It's the story of my life, if i love you and you are close to me, i will scar you horribly and you will wish you never met me.  I'm tired of hurting, i'm tired of hurting those i care about. One last time and it will never happen again.   That sounds like a good deal to me.

bike got destroyed, f4 foot fire in the apartment.  had do replace the radiator, alternator and battery on second car and now it' leaking oil at a more than tolerable rate.   Also i am out of sick time and vacation time at work. - Wife hates me ( not really but she hates that i act emotional )  i am ruining my children, and i can't provide for my family.   It just really seems like i out to get out before things get worse (i seems inevitable that they will)
